connectors.name: 2x4 connector (left column / right column)
connectors.orderNote: Printed numbers 1-4 per column; positions alternate left column then right column for each printed number (L1,R1,L2,R2,...)

uncertain: The table numbers pins 1-4 per column but the image does not mark which physical end of the vertical connector is pin 1; top-to-bottom mapping inferred from table order.

The rear panel shows two 2x4 connectors side by side (a dark female header and a white-outlined one); the callout zoom shows only the dark one. The white-outlined 2x4 connector has no labels and was not transcribed; it is unclear whether the table applies to it instead or as well.
notes: Callout titled 'ST-FH-254-0148-2x4P 2x4 CONNECTOR PINOUT' with LEFT COLUMN and RIGHT COLUMN tables. Connector id taken from the printed part designation with the multiplication sign written as x.
